logline_en: EXPLORATION SLOT: an animated one-statistic explainer — a single surprising, officially sourced number about life in Korea, revealed after a viewer guess.

evidence.claim: Korean agency analysis reports Shorts as the main discovery entry point for channels (88.2% of views).
Vendor roundup lists animated formats among trending Shorts in 2026.

hypotheses: H1: A 'guess the number' gap followed by an official citation earns more saves than our entertainment-only videos (information value).
H2: This format underperforms on raw views but over-performs on follows per 1k views (audience quality).
why_now: PROVISIONAL: no platform-measured candidates could be collected in this session (YouTube key missing, Instagram/Apify hosts blocked); evidence below is secondary and unverified. Re-rank against measured clusters before production spend. Deliberate exploration outside entertainment formats so the system does not only learn from one cluster.
creative_principle: Curiosity gap with a verifiable payoff: ask, let the viewer guess, reveal with the source on screen.
originality_notes: Statistics come from official sources (e.g. KOSIS, Statistics Korea), cited on screen; all visuals are original motion graphics.

script_ko.speaker: 내레이션
script_ko.line_ko: 한국 사람이 일 년에 이걸 몇 번이나 할까요?

script_ko.speaker: 내레이션
script_ko.line_ko: 출처는 화면에. 다음 숫자 궁금하면 저장.

edit_plan: Three beats only; the count-up animation carries the middle.
success_metric: Save rate and follows per 1k views above account median (even if views are below median).
risks: Must verify the statistic from the primary source before production — none is asserted in this brief
